title: Ho Ho Ho — EN/ES/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Spanish Portuguese language learning warm baritone 106bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family Christmas father celebratory
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Ho, ho, ho. Merry Xmas!! December twenty-fourth. Eight oh five PM.
Five calls on Christmas morning starting at five fifty-three AM.
We are awake!! Double exclamation. He kept trying.
That is Chas McIvor at Christmas.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Jo, jo, jo. ¡¡Feliz Navidad!! (Ho, ho, ho. Merry Xmas!!)
Veinticuatro de diciembre. Las ocho y cinco de la tarde. (December twenty-fourth. Eight oh five PM.)
Cinco llamadas en la mañana de Navidad empezando a las cinco cincuenta y tres. (Five calls Christmas morning starting at five fifty-three AM.)
¡¡Estamos despiertos!! Doble exclamación. Seguía intentando. (We are awake!! Double exclamation. He kept trying.)
Eso es Chas McIvor en Navidad. (That is Chas McIvor at Christmas.)
Las comas están en su lugar correcto. (The commas are in their right place.)
O al menos en el lugar donde Chas las quiere. (Or at least where Chas wants them.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Jo vírgula jo vírgula jo (Ho, ho, ho)
Feliz Natal (Merry Christmas)
Exclamação dupla (Double exclamation)
Jo vírgula jo vírgula jo (Ho, ho, ho)
Cinco chamadas na manhã de Natal (Five calls on Christmas morning)
Jo vírgula jo vírgula jo (Ho, ho, ho)
Estamos acordados (We are awake)
Exclamação dupla (Double exclamation)
Ele continuou tentando (He kept trying)
Porque é isso que o Natal é (Because that is what Christmas is)
Para o Chas (For Chas)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Sounds great, wish we could be there!! That exclamation mark is also real. He means it.
Spanish: Suena genial, ojalá pudiéramos estar ahí!! Ese signo de exclamación también es real. Lo dice en serio. (Sounds great, wish we could be there. That exclamation is real. He means it.)
Portuguese: Parece ótimo, queria poder estar lá!! Esse ponto de exclamação também é real. Ele quer dizer isso. (Sounds great, wish we could be there. That exclamation is real. He means it.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Ho, ho, ho — Merry Xmas — double exclamation — Chas McIvor — Christmas morning — five fifty-three AM
Spanish: Jo, jo, jo — Feliz Navidad — doble exclamación — Chas McIvor (Ho, ho, ho — Merry Xmas — double exclamation — Chas McIvor)
Portuguese: Jo, jo, jo — Feliz Natal — exclamação dupla — Chas McIvor (Ho, ho, ho — Merry Xmas — double exclamation — Chas McIvor)
